title: Eval Gatekeeper for model pin & config transitions
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Upgrading a model in the catalog or a customer-pinned model can introduce degradations that are only discovered in production usage. We need a lightweight, automated pre/post validation step that runs targeted evals and blocks or annotates pin/upgrade events when regressions are detected.

Goal: Ship an "eval gatekeeper" workflow that: (1) automatically runs a curated eval suite when a model version is pinned or when serving configs change; (2) computes pass/fail and delta metrics against the pinned baseline; (3) exposes a deterministic decision (allow / require human review / block); and (4) integrates with rollouts, release notes, and the Console rollback tooling.

Scope: Catalog model upgrades and customer-pinned model version changes only. Does not include ad-hoc user-provided models in this phase. The gatekeeper will support small, fast evals (smoke + regress tests) and will be extensible to full benchmark runs later.
acceptance_criteria: When a model version is pinned (catalog or customer pin), the gatekeeper automatically enqueues a predefined eval suite within 2 minutes
Eval suite returns pass/fail and numeric deltas for key metrics (accuracy, F1, perplexity, hallucination-rate, latency) and stores artifacts in the eval store
Decision logic maps deltas to actions: allow (<= threshold), flag-for-review (between thresholds), block-and-notify (>= critical threshold)
Gatekeeper decision is visible in the model catalog entry and the pinning event timeline in the Console
If gatekeeper blocks, the pin event is reverted and the actor and platform-admins receive email + Slack alerts with a link to eval artifacts and suggested mitigation steps
A minimal e2e test simulating a catalog pin (mock model) validates the workflow in CI with deterministic results
tasks: Design decision: define default eval suites for catalog vs customer pins (PM + ML lead)
Implement gatekeeper service API to subscribe to pin/config events (ENG)
Wire existing eval harness to run short smoke/regression jobs and surface results to gatekeeper (ENG/ML)
Decision engine: implement thresholds and triage rules; admin overrides for trusted users (PM/Eng)
Console UX: show gatekeeper verdicts, artifacts link, and quick rollback button (Design + Frontend)
Alerting: Slack/email templates and runbooks for blocked pins (SRE + Support)
Ship behind a feature flag; run on small internal accounts before broad rollout
